title: Present perfect and past 2 (I have done and I did)

exercises.instruction: Are the underlined parts of these sentences OK? Correct them where necessary.

items.prompt: I've lost my key. I can't find it anywhere.
Have you eaten a lot of sweets when you were a child?
I've bought a new car. You must come and see it.
I've bought a new car last week.
Where have you been yesterday evening?
I'm looking for Mike. Have you seen him?
'Have you been to Paris?' 'Yes, many times.'
I'm very hungry. I haven't eaten much today.
When has this bridge been built?

exercises.instruction: Make sentences from the words in brackets. Use the present perfect or past simple.

answers: The weather has been cold recently.
I didn't eat any fruit yesterday.
I haven't eaten any fruit today.

items.prompt: (Emily / earn / a lot of money / this year)
answers: Emily has earned a lot of money this year.

items.prompt: (she / not / earn / so much / last year)
answers: She didn't earn so much last year.
Have you had a holiday recently?
